name: NLW World Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Unclaimed as of the federation's own founding press conference, which announces a tournament to climax at the federation's first pay-per-view.

name: NLW World Tag Team Titles
epitaph: Unclaimed as of the federation's own founding press conference, which announces a tournament to climax at the federation's first pay-per-view, contingent on enough tag teams signing.

name: NLW North-American Title
epitaph: Unclaimed as of the federation's own founding press conference, which announces an over-the-top battle royal open to the full roster at the federation's first pay-per-view.
